feeds.what: every contest of the election, one row per precinct × contest × candidate (20,046 rows, 444 precincts, 76 contests). There are no statewide total rows: totals must be summed.
feeds.notes: A Dominion Democracy Suite ENR export sitting on S3 behind CloudFront (Server: AmazonS3). UTF-8, CRLF, no BOM, every line ends with a trailing comma. Not compressed on the wire (3.3 MB each fetch); it has an ETag ('c1e447393d105ee83a2ca6243158850d') and Last-Modified, so poll with If-None-Match. The page links it as 'Summary'. Columns: Precinct_name, Reporting_flag, Pct_Id, Pct_seq_nbr, Reg_voters, Aggregation_ID, Contest_Id, Contest_seq_nbr, Contest_title, Contest_party_name, Selectable_Options, Candidate_State_ID, candidate_id, candidate_name, Candidate_Type, cand_seq_nbr, Party_Code, total_ballots, total_votes, total_under_votes, total_over_votes, then the same four for Election Day, Absentee, Early Voting, Question, Remote. 'Precincts' include counting groups such as 'District 8 - Absentee', 'District 9 - Early Voting', 'HD99 Fed Overseas Absentee'. Alaska uses ranked-choice voting: these are FIRST-CHOICE votes only; RCV rounds are not in this file. Path pattern: /enr/<YY><ELECTION>/results/ with 26GENR = 2026 general.

feeds.what: the statewide summary report (PDF) — the only place the state totals appear ready-made
feeds.notes: Not machine-friendly; kept as a cross-check for summed totals. Per-house-district PDFs are at …/results/HD1.pdf … HD40.pdf (not fetched).

election_id: 26GENR, a path segment: /enr/26GENR/results/… (the site's other ids look like 24genr, 26prim, 26reaa in /election-results/e/?id=…).
discovery: No list endpoint. https://www.elections.alaska.gov/election-results/ shows the current election with the links above; past elections are at /election-results/e/?id=<yy><genr|prim|…>. For a future general, expect /enr/<YY>GENR/results/GA_ENR_Precinct_State_of_Alaska.csv, but confirm from the results page (the path is new: the directory listing /enr/26GENR/results/ answers 404).
cors: none (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin on the CSV when sent Origin: https://openslate.us)
bot_blocking: Plain relay User-Agent: 200 on the results page, the CSV and the PDF (CloudFront, no challenge). Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried.
updated_field: None inside the CSV. Use the HTTP Last-Modified header: 'Tue, 10 Nov 2026 00:40:26 GMT' (UTC). The results page also prints, for its ballot statistics table, 'Table last updated November 9, 2026 at 2:21 pm.' (Alaska time, no zone shown).
reporting_field: Reporting_flag per precinct row, but it was '0' on all 20,046 rows even though the rows carry votes, so its meaning could not be confirmed (it may only flip to 1 when a precinct is complete). Precinct count per contest = distinct Pct_Id values for that contest (U.S. Senator: 444). No 'precincts reporting' total anywhere in the file.
choice_format: candidate_name is 'Last, First M.' in quotes with Party_Code in its own column: "Peltola, Mary",C,2,"DEM"; "Sullivan, Dan S." REP. Party_Code can be empty ("Sullivan, Daniel J. Jr.") and is 'NON' for nonpartisan/undeclared. Governor is a ticket of surnames: "Kreiss-Tomkins/Johnson" with Party_Code "DEM/NON". Measures and judicial retention: candidate_name "YES" and "NO", empty Party_Code. Candidate_Type is 'C' on every row.
district_field: Only in the title: 'House District 1' (number), 'Senate District A' (letter). Alaska has one at-large US House seat, titled just 'U.S. Representative'. Contest_Id is an internal number (U.S. Senator = 6), not a district. Measure titles are internal codes ('BM#2 24ESEG' = Ballot Measure 2, petition 24ESEG), not the ballot wording.
terms: none found on the results page (the site footer links /website-disclaimer, not read)
